title: Hold a licence to grow or supply low-THC hemp
what: Possess, cultivate, process or supply low THC hemp for commercial purposes only under a commercial licence from the CEO; the Misuse of Drugs Act 1990 does not make unlawful what is done under the Hemp Industry Act (s 4A).

sources.title: Hemp Industry Act 2019 (NT)
sources.quote: A commercial licence authorises the licensee to possess, cultivate, process or supply low THC hemp for commercial purposes

sources.title: Misuse of Drugs Act 1990 (NT)
sources.quote: This Act does not affect the operation of the Hemp Industry Act 2019 or make unlawful anything done in accordance with that Act
